svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-aviator-shirt-male-tie","name":"Men's Aviator Shirt Uniform blue tie (overlay, registered to garment-aviator-shirt-male; also the group \"tie\" of the sheet)","size_in":{"w":27.4508,"h":28.4792},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2745.08,2847.92],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The tie of the sheet's group \"tie\" as an overlay: the Class A construction (base-art/tie.js: knot apex at the front of the collar, knot shoulder on the leaves' leading edge, neck, blade, tip) at the Class A coat's proportions (knot 1.8 in wide, blade 3 in at its widest), 21.9 in from knot apex to tip, the tip 80 % of the way down the belt buckle so it covers part of it and does not extend below it (4.2.5.1.4). g.title: Blue tie (the Class A construction, tie.js): knot in the collar opening under the leaves, blade down the placket, the tip over the belt buckle but not below it (CAPR 39-1 4.2.5.1.4); required with the long-sleeve shirt, optional with the short
